integrity.finite_verification: independent numerical support/area/perimeter checks; not a proof
integrity.proof_basis: elementary support-cone geometry and square-root endpoint analysis

limitations: The theorem is exact-data only and concerns centrally symmetric tangential polygons, not general convex polygons.
Close gap thresholds can be numerically ill-conditioned; no statistical stability estimate is proved.
Historical equivalence under different terminology is an identified residual risk.
title: Inverse classification of projection-width distributions for tangential symmetric polygons
